g.aria-label: Why Augmenting Only Real Images Leaks vs. Non-Leaking Augmentation
Apply random flip T_ρ only to x ~ p
Critic compares T_ρ p against q
Apply T_ρ to BOTH x and x' inside D
Critic compares T_ρ p against T_ρ q
T_ρ q = T_ρ p ⇒ q = p (Exact!)
Differentiating through T_ρ(G(z)) in D prevents memorization without corrupting q
